summary.text: Destiny LeVere Bolling is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 80, which covers part of Henrico County.
Destiny LeVere Bolling has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Destiny LeVere Bolling was born in Richmond, Virginia, in 1994.
Destiny LeVere Bolling studied at the University of Richmond (B.A., 2016) and George Washington University (M.A., International Affairs, 2018).
Destiny LeVere Bolling's listed occupation is communications director.
Destiny LeVere Bolling's listed memberships and affiliations include Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority (Upsilon Omega Chapter) and the Virginia State Conference of the NAACP (Labor and Industry Chair).
The profile lists Jon-Christopher B. Bolling as Destiny LeVere Bolling's spouse.
The House profile lists Destiny LeVere Bolling's committee assignments as Labor and Commerce, Privileges and Elections, and Education.
